name: Case law: United States, the trial and other courts of New Jersey
label: United States case law (the trial and other courts of New Jersey)
coverage: 21483 published opinions with text, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 86 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. Read from N.J. Eq., N.J. Super., N.J. Misc., N.J. Tax, A.3d, N.J.L., N.J.. The head matter (syllabi, headnotes, counsel) is left out: it is the publisher's text, not the court's. Every decision is a published opinion (precedential_status: published); CAP records no other status. CAP is a closed archive (its last volumes are of 2018-2020): no nightly runner appends to this repo. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.
update: none: the Caselaw Access Project is a static archive, so no nightly runner is registered

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)
source.reporters: N.J. Eq., N.J. Super., N.J. Misc., N.J. Tax, A.3d, N.J.L., N.J.
